name: Accentro Real Estate AG I
summary: Accentro Real Estate AG, along with its affiliated companies, operates as a key player in Germany's residential property market. The firm structures its operations across three primary divisions: Trading/Privatization Business, Portfolio Business, and Service Business. Its core activities involve managing the entire lifecycle of its proprietary real estate holdings, from acquisition and development to marketing, ownership, and leasing. Beyond its own portfolio, Accentro also functions as a real estate agency, providing brokerage services for properties owned by third parties. Furthermore, the company offers specialized services catering to a diverse clientele, including individuals purchasing homes for personal use, investors focused on rental income, and large institutional investors. Its service offerings extend to apartment marketing, property valuations and surveys, and various digital transformation initiatives. Established in 1993, Accentro Real Estate AG is headquartered in Berlin, Germany, and operates as a subsidiary of Brookline Real Estate S.à r.l.
